Class FakePlatform

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.testing.FakePlatform
All Implemented Interfaces:
Platform
public final class FakePlatform extends Object implements Platform
A Platform with the operating system of your choice and its directories under a root directory, such as a test's temporary directory. Code that receives a Platform can be tested on any operating system, whatever the one the tests run on, without touching the real directories.

The operating system only sets isLinux(), isMacOS() and isWindows(); the directories are FakeDirectories under the root unless others are given, and the file system is that of the root. 

Platform platform = FakePlatform.newBuilder(OperatingSystem.WINDOWS, temporaryDirectory).build();

To run the real detection of the directories of an operating system instead, give Platform.newBuilder() the system properties and environment variables of a PlatformPreset.

Before 0.1.2, it was be.imgn.gaia.platform.testing.FakePlatform, in its own module, gaia-platform-testing.

Since:
